class.name: LevelStreamCell3D
class.brief_description: One streamed part of a level: an ordinary scene file loaded while the target of its [LevelStreamer3D] is near.
class.description: Place cells below a [LevelStreamer3D] (directly or deeper) and give each a [member scene_path]. The cell's box (see [member size]) is where its content is; the streamer measures the target's distance to that box. The cell's scene is added as the cell's child, so it is authored in the cell's local space, centered on the cell's origin. Each cell has a [member cell_id] that saved state and neighbors refer to. A new cell gets one from its node name; keep it when renaming the node. The editor warns about a missing streamer, a missing or duplicate ID, a missing scene, an unload distance below the preload distance, an empty size and unknown neighbors.

method.name: contains
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param global_point] is inside the cell's box.

method.name: distance_to
method.description: Returns the distance from [param global_point] to the cell's box, 0 inside it. The cell's scale is assumed uniform.

method.name: get_content
method.description: Returns the root of the cell's instantiated scene while the cell is active or ready, or [code]null[/code].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the cell loads when the level starts and never unloads.
The cell's stable ID, unique under its streamer. Saved state, neighbors and the [LevelStreamer3D] methods refer to it.

IDs of cells loaded whenever the target is inside this cell, whatever their distance: for example the interior behind a door, so its lights, collision and navigation are there before the target reaches it.
The cell starts to load when the target is this close to its box.
The scene streamed into this cell. It is loaded only when needed, but exported with the project.
The size of the cell's box, centered on the cell's origin.
The cell unloads when the target is farther than this from its box. Keep it larger than [member preload_distance].
